chunks: It was narrated to me by Ali ibn Ahmad from his father from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Muhammad ibn Khalid and Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said:
The Almighty Allah will cover with His Own cover one who goes to bathroom wrapping a cloth around himself.

key_terms.مِئْزَر: A type of garment or cloth used for covering

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for covering oneself with a cloth when entering the bathroom?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elevates the mundane act of using a *mi'zar* (loincloth) into a spiritual safeguard, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *haya* (modesty) extending even to private spaces. The promise that Allah covers the individual with His own *satr* (veiling/protection) underscores the concept of divine reciprocity for maintaining dignity, linking physical preparation to spiritual protection from the gaze of angels or hidden flaws.
